articles.title: Travis Kelce’s early NFL days revisited as Bernard Pollard recalls ‘decapitated’ hit on Chiefs star
articles.summary: Former Kansas City Chiefs safety Bernard Pollard has recalled delivering a huge hit on Travis Kelce early in the tight end’s NFL career.
articles.body: Former Kansas City Chiefs safety Bernard Pollard has recalled delivering a huge hit on Travis Kelce early in the tight end’s NFL career. Pollard revealed that the moment became Kelce’s introduction to the physical side of professional football. The former safety also admitted that Kelce still brings up the incident during interviews. While remembering their on-field encounter, Pollard praised how much the Chiefs star has achieved since then. His comments come as the 37-year-old Kelce continues to play an important role in Kansas City’s offense during the 2026 NFL season.Bernard Pollard recalls the huge hit that gave Travis Kelce his ‘Welcome to the NFL’ momentPollard, who played safety for the Kansas City Chiefs from 2006 to 2008, discussed the incident during a recent interview with Kyle Odegard of RotoGrinders. He looked back at the early days of Kelce’s career and described how he introduced the young tight end to the kind of physical challenges he would face in the NFL.Remembering the encounter, Pollard did not hold back while describing the hit. He also revealed that Kelce has continued to mention the moment years after it happened.“I played him early in his career and I absolutely decapitated him. He still talks about that to this day when he does interviews. That was his ‘Welcome to the NFL’ moment. He knew he couldn’t just be running around like that in the NFL.”Pollard’s comments show that the incident remained a memorable part of their playing days. For Kelce, who was still finding his place in the league at the time, the experience was a reminder that defenders would not make things easy for him.However, Pollard’s recollection was not limited to the hard hit. He also spoke about the progress Kelce has made since those early years and the success he has enjoyed with Kansas City.“It’s really cool what Travis is doing. It’s been fun to see the growth he had and all the success he’s had in the National Football League. He’s been special.”Travis Kelce continues to produce for Kansas City Chiefs at 37Kelce has continued to be an important part of the Chiefs’ passing game in the 2026 season. Playing in his 14th NFL campaign, the tight end remains a trusted target for quarterback Patrick Mahomes and has led Kansas City in receiving yards through nine games.According to the Kansas City Chiefs’ official player statistics, Kelce has recorded 35 receptions for 512 receiving yards and two receiving touchdowns. His average of 14.6 yards per catch has also been a strong part of his season.The veteran has contributed beyond his receiving numbers as well. He has one rushing attempt for one yard, which resulted in a touchdown. That gives him three total touchdowns this season, including his two receiving scores.At 37, Kelce continues to give the Chiefs another reliable option in their offense. His ability to make catches and gain yards has kept him involved in the team’s plans as the season moves forward.Kansas City is scheduled to face the Arizona Cardinals in its Week 11 game on Sunday, November 22. The Chiefs will host the Cardinals at 1 p.m. ET, with the game set to air on CBS. Kelce will once again be an important player to watch as Kansas City looks to add another win to its season.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Tom Brady's sports investment delivers an unexpected environmental victory with 19,500kg of plastic waste removed
articles.summary: Tom Brady had spent much of his career chasing trophies, but his investment in electric powerboat racing gave him another way to measure success.
articles.body: Tom Brady had spent much of his career chasing trophies, but his investment in electric powerboat racing gave him another way to measure success. His Team Brady outfit connected its performance on the water with a campaign to tackle plastic pollution. On December 17, 2025, the team received the first-ever E1 Blue Impact Championship title after its Race for Change initiative helped fund the removal of 19,500kg of plastic waste from oceans, rivers and coastlines. The achievement gave Brady's sporting venture a purpose that reached far beyond the finish line.Tom Brady's Team Brady linked racing points with ocean clean-upThe initiative followed a simple idea: every point earned by Team Brady during the 2025 E1 World Championship triggered the removal of 100kg of plastic waste through its partnership with the 4ocean Foundation. The model tied the team's results directly to an environmental cause, giving each race a second outcome beyond its position in the standings.Team Brady worked with 4ocean Foundation, OceanR, OMP and WaterAid through its Race for Change programme. The partnerships extended the campaign beyond collecting rubbish. OceanR produced the team's clothing using recycled plastic waste, helping prevent 4,112 plastic bottles from entering landfill. The team also worked with WaterAid to raise awareness about access to clean and safe drinking water.The campaign earned recognition from E1, the world's first all-electric raceboat championship. Judges assessed teams on their contributions to marine ecosystems, local communities and wider environmental awareness. Team Brady secured the Blue Impact title alongside its second E1 championship victory.Brady said the recognition mattered because the team had aimed to make a difference beyond competition.“Winning the E1 Championship for a second time this year is special, and earning the first ever Blue Impact Championship title means a lot. When we first set out to build the team with team principals Ben and Joe, our goal was to win both on and off the water – and we’ve done exactly that.“Our Race for Change platform has been a driving force for real environmental impact, and it was important to all of us that our commitment went beyond words. We wanted measurable change. I’m proud that we’re not just talking about doing good – we’re actually doing it. Seeing my team recognised for their hard work is truly inspiring.”Tom Brady's electric boat racing investment carried a wider purposeThe result also highlighted how sports teams could use competition to support causes outside their usual fan base. Team Brady's approach gave supporters a clear link between sporting performance and environmental action. It also placed sustainability at the centre of the team's identity rather than treating it as a separate campaign.The 19,500kg figure came from the team's performance-linked partnership with 4ocean, not from a claim that the racing itself removed pollution. That distinction mattered. The boats competed, earned points and helped fund clean-up operations carried out by the foundation.For Brady, the 2025 season showed that a sports investment could pursue two goals at once: winning championships and supporting measurable environmental work.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Rams WR Puka Nacua reportedly out 4-5 months following knee surgery, will be sidelined for playoffs
articles.summary: Even if Sean McVay's team finds its way into the postseason, it won't have its top receiver, according to an ESPN report.
articles.body:
While the Los Angeles Rams try to make the most of a 2026 campaign that began with astronomical expectations, wide receiver Puka Nacua is already working toward 2027. He had MCL surgery on Tuesday, and his recovery timeline is considered to be four to five months, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Saturday night .

Based on that reported prognosis, the 25-year-old Nacua will miss the remainder of the regular season and the playoffs.

The two-time All-Pro wideout received recommendations from three doctors to undergo the procedure, per ESPN's latest report, which noted that team doctor Neal ElAttrache performed the operation.

The Rams placed Nacua on injured reserve with knee and turf toe injuries on Nov. 12 , a week before the NFL imposed its suspension. Like any player who lands on IR, Nacua had to sit out four games before he could return. By the time the suspension was announced, the length of that ban and his remaining time on IR were aligned.

While that situation understandably turned heads, it's worth noting that Nacua isn't the first player to serve a suspension while on IR.

The last year has been a head-scratching one for Nacua, who's among the best wide receivers in the sport but has run into off-field trouble.

This past offseason, news broke that a woman was suing Nacua. She alleged that, on Dec. 31, 2025, he made an antisemitic statement and later bit her on the shoulder. Nacua's attorney denied the woman's claim that he made such a comment and downplayed the biting as "horseplay."

In seven games this season, Nacua — the league's 2025 receptions leader — piled up 70 catches for 715 yards and 4 touchdowns. He also scored on the ground once for a 6-4 Rams team that's hardly had the start it envisioned this fall.

Nacua's injuries occurred on the final offensive snap of L.A.'s Week 9 win over the Washington Commanders. He's in the last year of his rookie contract.

His future in L.A. has yet to be determined, and he won't be available for the Rams in the short term. That said, the Rams are hoping to get veteran wide receiver Davante Adams back down the stretch, as they make a push for the playoffs .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany celebrate another championship as KC Current add NWSL glory to their growing sports legacy
articles.summary: The Kansas City Current have given Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes another championship to celebrate, this time outside the NFL.
articles.body: The Kansas City Current have given Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes another championship to celebrate, this time outside the NFL. The club, co-owned by the couple, beat the Washington Spirit in Saturday night’s NWSL Championship game to claim the first title in its history. Brittany watched from Audi Field in Washington, D.C., and joined the players on the field after the final whistle. Patrick was preparing for the Kansas City Chiefs’ Week 11 game against the Arizona Cardinals, but the result added a notable milestone to the family’s growing involvement in Kansas City sports.Brittany Mahomes joins KC Current's first championship celebrationBrittany’s presence at Audi Field made the ownership connection visible throughout the night. Cameras picked her out during the match, including when Vanessa DiBernardo put the Current ahead with an Olympico goal, scored directly from a corner.She arrived in a teal trench coat and red knee-high boots, echoing the team’s colours for the championship occasion. Her reaction to DiBernardo’s goal was lively, but the postgame scenes carried more weight. After the final whistle, Brittany went down to the pitch, embraced players and joined the team on stage as the celebrations continued.For Brittany, this was more than a chance to watch a team she supports lift a trophy. She is part of the ownership group behind the club, and the first championship gives that investment a landmark result. The Current have now secured the biggest prize in their history, with Brittany sharing the moment directly with the players.The 2-1 result gave the Current a clear finish to a demanding final against Washington, and made the postgame medal presentation a fitting celebration for a club reaching this point for the first time.Patrick Mahomes adds NWSL success to his sports ownership portfolioThe victory adds a different kind of achievement to the Mahomes family’s sporting story. Patrick is best known for his work with the Chiefs, while Brittany’s role with the Current gives the couple a presence in another major professional league. Their involvement goes beyond backing a local team from the stands. They co-own a club that has now delivered the biggest result in its history.Patrick’s absence in Washington was down to the Chiefs’ schedule. Kansas City was due to face the Arizona Cardinals at Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday afternoon, leaving him little room to attend the NWSL final. Brittany represented the family at Audi Field and joined the on-field celebration, collecting a championship medal on stage alongside the players.The win gives the couple another sporting milestone, but it also creates a new challenge for the club. The Current now have a title to defend and a standard to maintain. Whether they can turn this first NWSL crown into sustained success will be the next test. For now, Brittany got to celebrate the achievement with the team, while Patrick prepared for his own game the following day.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes helped build the KC Current into a $325 million franchise, and their first NWSL championship could make it even more valuable
articles.summary: The Kansas City Current won their first NWSL championship on Saturday, beating the Washington Spirit 2-1 at Audi Field.
articles.body: The Kansas City Current won their first NWSL championship on Saturday, beating the Washington Spirit 2-1 at Audi Field. Vanessa DiBernardo scored from a corner kick, and Debinha added a late breakaway goal. The title arrives with a price tag already attached. Forbes valued the club at $325 million this year, second in the league behind Angel City. Brittany Mahomes helped found the team in December 2020, when it had no stadium and no history. Now comes the business question: does a trophy make the club worth more?How Brittany Mahomes helped build a $325 million franchiseBrittany Mahomes did not write every check, and it helps to say so plainly. Angie and Chris Long are the majority owners. Chris runs Palmer Square Capital Management, and the couple led the push to build CPKC Stadium. Brittany brought an early yes and a name people in Kansas City already knew. A former forward at UT Tyler, she joined the Longs in December 2020 as a founding co-owner, back when the club was a promise on paper.The first results were ugly. The Current finished last in the league in 2021. The owners kept building anyway. Patrick Mahomes joined the group in January 2023, the first active NFL player to own part of an NWSL team. In March 2024 the club opened CPKC Stadium, a $140 million venue financed privately and widely called the first built for a women's pro team. A $52 million training center followed.Money followed the buildings. Sportico counted $42.9 million in revenue for the Current in 2025, up from $36 million in 2024, when the club led the league. Brittany also joined the NWSL's advisory board in 2025, which gives her a voice in where the league goes next.How the KC Current beat the Spirit for their first NWSL titleA year ago, this story ended differently. The Current won the 2025 Shield in record time, then lost a playoff game to Gotham FC. Brittany posted afterward: "We'll be back. Thank you KC for the most incredible season."This year was messier. Kansas City entered the playoffs as the fourth seed under first-year coach Chris Armas. They beat Gotham 2-1 in the semifinal, with Haley Hopkins scoring in the 89th minute, then traveled to face a Spirit side playing near home.The final was rough. The Guardian reported 19 fouls in the first half, the most in any half of an NWSL final. DiBernardo broke the game open in the 54th minute with a corner that curled into the far side of the net. At 34, she became the oldest player to score in an NWSL final and was named MVP. She had her first child in January and returned in March. "This one just felt a little lighter," she said.Debinha settled it in stoppage time, rounding goalkeeper Sandy MacIver after Kansas City won the ball back. Trinity Rodman pulled one back with a header in the 98th minute, but the Spirit never found the equalizer. Washington has now lost three straight finals.Can one trophy raise a $325 million valuation?Not directly. Forbes and Sportico build their lists on revenue, recent team sales and league growth, not on trophies. Both lists also came out before this final. Forbes put the Current at $325 million, up 18% from $275 million a year earlier. Sportico had them at $315 million, with the league average at $184 million, up 77% since 2024.The trophy works through revenue. A champion sells more sponsorships, more jerseys and more media time, and it gets an earlier call when brands pick partners. Sportico's 2024 study valued NWSL clubs at about 6.8 times revenue on average. As a rough guide, and this is my own arithmetic rather than a forecast, every extra $5 million in yearly revenue would add about $34 million in value.There is also a story effect. Forbes noted that for many clubs lower in the table, valuations reflect investor bets on league growth more than current business. A championship gives buyers a better story to bet on. In a league where Denver paid a $110 million expansion fee, stories matter.Where the KC Current's growth could hit a ceilingDemand is the easy part of the argument. Room is the hard part. CPKC Stadium drew 11,500 fans for its opening match, and the club has sold out its home games, so ticket income sits close to its limit. Prices can rise. Seats cannot.That pushes the next dollars toward sponsors, media and non-matchday business, which is where a champion has leverage. Forbes also estimated that the Current could move out of the red this year. That matters in a league where, according to Sportico, every club lost money in 2024.The gap at the top is small. Angel City leads the Forbes list by $15 million, and the Spirit, who just lost the final, sit at $215 million. A title could narrow the attention gap even if Angel City stays first.Nobody can put a number on the bump today, and anyone who does is guessing. The real test comes when Forbes next updates its list, after a full offseason of sponsor talks with a championship to sell.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Tennessee Titans scouted SMU vs. Notre Dame on Saturday
articles.summary: The Tennessee Titans hold five top 65 picks in the 2027 NFL Draft and scouts were spotted at the SMU versus Notre Dame game.
articles.body:
The college football season is in the home stretch heading into Week 13, and NFL scouting departments nationwide are busy evaluating talent ahead of the 2027 NFL Draft.

As you all know, the Tennessee Titans are tough to track, with their scouting department apparently using stealth technology to keep their targets hidden, and now that they would hold the first-overall selection, that is a bit frustrating.

Heading into the draft, Tennessee holds nine picks including two first-round and two second-round picks, giving them five of the top 65 selections.

The Titans have had back-to-back solid drafts and have started to lay a solid foundation. General manager Mike Borgonzi has talked about adding talent through the draft, and any added picks could speed up the process.

This week has been no different, with the Titans' scouts being less visible than those from other organizations. Here is a look at the game where Tennessee was known to have a presence.

This game does feature some intriguing prospects that could interest the Titans from both teams, including cornerback Leonard Moore, edge Boubacar Traore, offensive lineman Guerby Lambert and safety Luke Talich from Notre Dame and offensive tackle PJ Williams and tight end Theo Melin-Ohrstrom from SMU

articles.title: Do the Packers play today? Schedule, next game after bye
articles.summary: Do the Green Bay Packers play today? Here’s what to know about their schedule and games today during Week 11 of the NFL season.
articles.body:
The Green Bay Packer have reached a unique portion of their 2026 schedule.

They are off in Week 11 but they won't be getting a full two weeks between games normally afforded to teams on a bye.

Matt LaFleur's Packers will already return to the field on Wednesday, Nov. 25, for the NFL's first-ever game on Thanksgiving Eve.

They'll then actually have more days off before their following game than they did during their official bye week.

Either way, the actual bye comes at a critical juncture in the season for the Packers. They're a week removed from an ugly showing in an important NFC North game at home, putting any division title hopes on life support.

The importance from here on out only intensifies if the Packers, at 6-4 through 10 games, have aspirations of reaching the playoffs for a fourth straight year.

The bye, even though it's shorter than normal, does give players banged up a few extra days to recover. And the biggest development could come with All-Pro edge rusher Micah Parsons, who appears poised to play in his first game in over 11 months after tearing his ACL in December 2025.

Here's what to know about the Packers' schedule, next game, Week 11 games on Sunday, NFC North standings and more:

Here are the Packers injuries during the 2026 season

No, the Packers do not play today, Nov. 22. They have a bye in Week 11.

After a 1-2 start, the Packers won five of six games to get to 6-3. But then it came crashing down again last week against the Minnesota Vikings in a 30-10 loss at Lambeau Field.

See Aaron Rodgers' and Mike McCarthy's relationship over the years

The Packers return to the field in just a matter of days when they play the Los Angeles Rams in the NFL's first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game on Wednesday, Nov. 25. The Packers-Rams game kicks off the Week 12 slate and holiday schedule that includes three games on Thanksgiving and one on Black Friday.

The matchup is scheduled for 7 p.m. at SoFi Stadium.

And it's a crucial game for both squads. The Packers and Rams are each 6-4 and fighting to make a playoff push.

While the Rams have sustained major injuries to key offensive players, they have won four straight games, while Green Bay has split its last four.

Like the Packers, the Rams have a bye in Week 11 due to the rare Wednesday game in Week 12.

Relive Packers vs Rams during the 1996 Super Bowl-winning season

The NFC North is the only division in which all four teams have records above .500.

Baltimore Ravens at Carolina Panthers , noon, FOX

New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears, noon, FOX

Tennessee Titans at Dallas Cowboys, noon., FOX

Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions, noon, FOX

Arizona Cardinals at Kansas City Chiefs, noon, CBS

Pittsburgh Steelers at Philadelphia Eagles, noon, CBS

New York Jets at Los Angeles Chargers, 3:05 p.m., FOX

Jacksonville Jaguars at New York Giants, 3:25 p.m., CBS

Las Vegas Raiders at Denver Broncos, 3:25 p.m., CBS

Minnesota Vikings vs. San Francisco 49ers (in Mexico City), 7:20 p.m., NBC/Peacock

Green Bay Packers 2026 schedule in photos

The Packers have two consecutive road games after the bye. But then they have four of their final five games of the season at Lambeau Field. The only road game in that stretch is a trip to Soldier Field to play the Chicago Bears on Christmas Day.

It's the second straight year that Jayden Reed experienced a major injury. He had a broken collarbone in 2025, an injury that kept him out for a significant part of the season. (Elsa, Getty Images)

ZACH BAKO-BEWELE Zach Bako-Bewele has a torn patellar tendon in his right knee a play after Jayden Reed went out in the Packers' Week 2 game at the New York Jets. Status: Out for season, on injured reserve (Brad Penner, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect)
Zach Bako-Bewele also tore his patellar tendon last December, an injury that kept him out of nearly all of the offseason activities. (Vincent Carchietta, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect)

EDGERRIN COOPER Linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a ruptured Achilles tendon on a non-contact play in the Packers' game at the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 4 on Oct. 4. Status: Out for season, on injured reserve (Matt Pendleton, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect)

JAVON HARGRAVE Defensive lineman Javon Hargrave is tended to after going down with a torn Achilles late in the Packers' Week 5 game against the Chicago Bears Oct. 11 at Lambeau Field. Status: Out for season, on injured reserve (Michael Reaves, Getty Images)
Javon Hargrave gets well wishes from his teammates, including Micah Parsons, before he's carted away with a season-ending Achilles injury. (Tork Mason/Green Bay Press-Gazette)

SEAN RHYAN Offensive lineman Sean Rhyan sustained a high-ankle sprain early in the Packers' Week 7 game against the Detroit Lions Oct. 25. He has missed the last three games. Status: Rhyan isn't on injured reserve, but he has not practiced since the injury. Since he didn't go on IR and with the bye coming up it's possible he could return in the Thanksgiving Eve game on Nov. 25. (Al Bello, Getty Images)

articles.title: ‘Expert in broken relationships’: Fans blast Dianna Russini’s take on Brandon Aiyuk’s failed NFL return
articles.summary: Dianna Russini lands in hot water with NFL fans after her latest take on Brandon Aiyuk. It has been more than two years since Brandon Aiyuk played for the Sa...
articles.body:
Dianna Russini lands in hot water with NFL fans after her latest take on Brandon Aiyuk.

It has been more than two years since Brandon Aiyuk played for the San Francisco 49ers. Initially, Aiyuk was ruled out due to a severe knee injury.

But Aiyuk still has returned to the field despite recovering from his injury due to his contract disputes with the 49ers.

NFL analyst Dianna Russini decided to share her two cents on Aiyuk's failed attempt in 2026, but her take didn't sit well with fans.

Dianna Russini reveals what's really happening between Brandon Aiyuk and San Francisco 49ers

During a recent episode of her podcast, 'The Russini Report,' the former ESPN analyst explained the real reason why Aiyuk hasn't been able to return to the 49ers, and it has nothing to do with his knee injury.

"This stopped being about a knee a long time ago. This is about money, trust, and a relationship that broke somewhere along the way. Could he still help them? Yeah, of course.

"Look at San Francisco's injury report and tell me they couldn't use him, but this is about culture. This is about a team that knows what it is, who wants, and knows what it wants to be," Russini said.

She then explained that the 49ers already have a room full of veteran leaders, including George Kittle and they simply no longer need Aiyuk in the mix before delivering the final nail in the coffin.

"So where do things stand right now? I can tell you based on talking to players and people close to the situation. This is not going to end in a reunion, and the plan is for the 49ers to release him," she concluded.

If Russini's report is correct, then there's a very high chance that Aiyuk has already played his final game with the 49ers.

Dianna Russini gets trolled by NFL fans for her Brandon Aiyuk take

However, NFL fans on X didn't seem to agree with the analyst's take and made fun of her comments instead.

"I think Russini knows a thing or two about broken relationships," a fan wrote. While another added, "She's an expert in broken relationships."

"Stop lying, stop being a fraud – you have zero credibility," a third fan stated angrily. "You had to know this post wasn't going to go well this HAD to be intentional," a fourth fan noted.

"I respect posting through it because you gotta keep it moving. Wording could be better," a fifth fan advised.

As expected, most fans made it about her alleged affair with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel and ignored what she had to say about the Aiyuk situation.

articles.title: From a $503 million Chiefs contract to a $1 billion MLB franchise deal , Patrick Mahomes is building a sports empire across four leagues
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes has built his reputation through record-breaking performances on the football field, but his ambitions reach well beyond the NFL.
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes has built his reputation through record-breaking performances on the football field, but his ambitions reach well beyond the NFL. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback has steadily expanded his presence in professional sports, backing teams across soccer, baseball and motorsport. His growing portfolio reflects a wider interest in sports ownership and the business opportunities that come with it. While his involvement with the Kansas City Current has attracted fresh attention ahead of the 2026 NWSL Championship, the women's soccer club is only one part of his expanding investment journey.Patrick Mahomes' soccer investments include the KC Current and Sporting Kansas CityMahomes and his wife, Brittany, joined the Kansas City Current ownership group in January 2023. The move made him the first active NFL player to hold an ownership stake in an NWSL club. Their involvement has also brought another connection between the Chiefs star and Kansas City's growing sports scene.The Current have since enjoyed success, including their 2024 NWSL x Liga MX Femenil Summer Cup triumph. Now, the club has another major opportunity as it faces the Washington Spirit in the 2026 NWSL Championship on November 21. A league title would give the ownership group another reason to celebrate and mark a significant moment for the club.However, Mahomes' soccer interests began before his involvement with the Current. In July 2021, he became part of the ownership group at Sporting Kansas City, the city's Major League Soccer club. He holds a minority stake in Sporting Club, while businessman Cliff Illig remains the team's principal owner.These investments show that Mahomes' interest in soccer is not limited to one competition. He has backed both the women's and men's professional game in his home city.Patrick Mahomes has investments in the Kansas City Royals and Alpine F1Soccer is just one part of Mahomes' growing sports portfolio. The quarterback also owns a minority stake in the Kansas City Royals, joining the MLB franchise's ownership group in July 2020.The investment followed John Sherman's $1 billion purchase of the team in 2019. It gave Mahomes a connection to another major Kansas City sports institution beyond the Chiefs.His interests also extend to international motorsport. In late 2023, Mahomes joined an investor consortium led by Otro Capital that acquired a minority stake in Alpine's Formula 1 team.The move placed him among a group of high-profile investors exploring opportunities in one of the world's most popular racing competitions.For Mahomes, these investments represent more than a collection of team affiliations. They connect him with different fan communities and sports businesses while allowing him to support franchises beyond his playing career. At 31, he remains an active NFL quarterback, but his growing ownership interests suggest he is already building a future in the wider sports industry.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Eagles News: ESPN predicts a Philadelphia upset
articles.summary: Philadelphia Eagles news and links for 11/22/26.
articles.body:
Welcome to The Linc, the daily Philadelphia Eagles links roundup at Bleeding Green Nation!

Might the Philadelphia Eagles actually win a football game today?! I'm not counting on it. But I do think it's more possible after seeing the Pittsburgh Steelers drop from being 4.5-point road favorites to 3.5-point road favorites.

Let's get to the Philadelphia Eagles news and links …

Philadelphia Eagles +4.5 (+180 moneyline) vs. Pittsburgh Steelers. Quarterback Aaron Rodgers hasn't given much reason to trust Pittsburgh laying points on the road Sunday. Philadelphia's specialty is playing more man coverage and sending extra rushers, both of which have bothered Rodgers in 2026. Plus, defensive tackle Jalen Carter can attack an offensive line that just lost guard Mason McCormick (ankle). Eagles backup QB Joe Milton taking sacks is the main concern for their offense, but he can still get positive yards as a scrambler. With wide receiver DeVonta Smith potentially returning from a hamstring injury, the Eagles have enough to win this by a field goal.

The Eagles have been so bad this season that they've forced me to change what I write about. I really enjoy studying opposing teams for the weekly previews, but I'm already more interested in what the Eagles might look like next year. So, over the remaining weeks of the season, I'm going to examine potential coaching candidates and some offenses and defenses that interest me. Obviously, this depends on the Eagles making changes, and in this particular case, the Colts letting Shane Steichen go. Neither is guaranteed. However, I thought it would be interesting to look beyond the record and examine whether Steichen is still someone Eagles fans should want back.

The Steelers are getting one of their top wide receivers back ahead of Week 11's matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles. Pittsburgh announced Saturday that wide receiver Roman Wilson has been activated to the 53-man roster ahead of Sunday's game. In addition, the team announced the signing of edge rusher K.J. Henry from the practice squad to the roster. The two signings fill the open spots on the Steelers' roster. The Henry signing follows the Steelers announcing outside linebacker Nick Herbig as out for Sunday's game. Now, Pittsburgh has an open slot on its practice squad.

Expect to see Ty Robinson take some of the nose-tackle snaps previously reserved for Jordan Davis at the heart of the Eagles defense this season. He's an unconventional fit for the position at 6-foot-5, 288 pounds, but Eagles defensive coordinator Vic Fangio said the second-year lineman out of Nebraska has gotten extensive work in practice playing as a zero technique and believes he can hold up even with a relatively smaller frame for the role. "The nose tackle isn't totally the position that is viewed as it was in the past," Fangio said. "When there was a two back running game and there was a lot of [isolation runs] where he would get a lot, a lot of double teams. It still happens, but not as much as it used to." Robinson said it would be "big shoes" to fill in for Davis, but wasn't concerned about his size in the new role. "All last year I was learning all three positions," Robinson said. "The playbook is the easiest part now. It's just about going out there and executing and trying to fill the shoes of Jordan Davis. And those are some big shoes to fill. … It's just about the heart of the dog in the fight. I go against Jordan Mailata every day. That dude's massive. We go against massive dudes. It's nothing discouraging, just going out there and playing the way I know how to play."

Nolan Smith and Jordan Davis were teammates at Georgia and then became teammates again in the NFL. They have been friends for a long time. But there's no time to be sad. "Man, he's a great guy," Smith said on Friday. "That's part of the business. That's how it goes. I'm pretty sure Jacksonville is picking up a good player. But we have to focus on us. We have leaders in this locker room. We've got guys who can lead and push guys." Davis was traded to the Jaguars ahead of the trade deadline last week and this was the first chance to catch up with Smith since the trade. So it has been over a week since it all went down. Jalen Carter, who also played with Davis at Georgia before becoming teammates in the NFL, was again not available to reporters this week. The return on the Davis trade for the Eagles was undeniable. Getting a first-round pick and second-round pick for Davis represented incredible value. But it doesn't mean they won't miss Davis. "Man, it was special," Smith said of their time together in Philly. "But that time come and go, man. I'm still playing with guys that I played with at Georgia. But that was a real special moment, though."

Handling the Steelers' blitz game. There are individual stars here – T.J. Watt has 7.5 sacks and 9 tackles for loss – but it's the collective that makes the Steelers so good on defense. They bring pressure and they aren't afraid to expose their back end to one-on-one matchups and that's why having Smith is so critical. They can win those matchups. But the Eagles first have to handle pressure. Quarterback Joe Milton III said he has confidence in how much he worked to advance his understanding of the scheme and of what Pittsburgh does, so we will see how the Eagles react. Milton ran for 65 yards against the Giants two weeks ago. He can gash the blitz with his legs, but the Eagles also need to make the passing game go and avoid negative plays.

The Cincinnati Bengals have placed [Eagles Super Bowl LIX champion] linebacker Oren Burks on the injured reserve list with a groin injury, the team announced on Saturday. Burks, a ninth-year player, has played in all nine games this season, totaling seven tackles and one tackle for loss on defense to go with nine tackles on special teams. He suffered his injury during the team's Week 10 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.

Fast-forward nine games, and the Giants' secondary has been much, much, better than anticipated under [former Eagles assistant] Dennard Wilson, Donald D'Alesio, and Addison Lynch. The Giants are currently fielding the NFL's fourth-best defense in total yardage allowed (2,751 total yards). They're third-best in passing yardage allowed per game (184.1 yards per game), second in yards per completion allowed (9.8 yards per completion), and 2nd in yards per attempt allowed (6.2 yards per attempt). The Giants are accomplishing this feat with smothering coverage from their starting corners. Both Deonte Banks and Greg Newsome II have been incredibly sticky in man coverage, allowing little separation for receivers.

The Dallas Cowboys desperately need a win, and Sunday's matchup against the Tennessee Titans offers a chance to get something positive going after all the Christian Parker drama. Tennessee is 1-8 and has one of the league's worst defenses, particularly in the secondary. Dallas should have plenty of opportunities to move the ball through the air, especially with CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens coming off productive performances. There are still reasons to be cautious. The Cowboys' defense has been a disaster this year, and Tennessee quarterback Cam Ward has improved over the past few weeks. With Dallas also changing its defensive play-calling, this matchup could tell us a lot about the team's direction. Here are two players to buy and one area to sell ahead of Sunday's game.

Washington's defense will be tested by the Cincinnati Bengals offense, which has scored 30-plus points in their last five games. Quarterback Joe Burrow might be this defense's kryptonite, considering how well he and the Bengals coaching staff handles the blitz. Burrow has the third-highest success rate when facing five rushers or more and has the NFL's highest completion rate at 73.4% against the blitz. Also, Jones said that Cincinnati prioritizes protection and does a good job disguising their work in pass pro. Does all that impact how Jones will call Monday night's game? He isn't volunteering that. He did provide the primary objective, to keep Burrow off balance. "We have to, in some way shape or form, provide mental stress," Jones said. "He can't be sitting back there knowing our coverage. We have to find a way to change the picture. It's going to become a chess match."

Grand Theft Auto VI is the highest-budget entertainment product in history, and if you've spent any time with the game, you'd understand why. The attention to detail is alarming; the depth of Rockstar's version of Florida is staggering — and the in-game radio has some of the most stunning celebrity DJs imaginable. One of these is comedian Stavros Halkias, who hosts a sports talk radio show that is completely off the rails. Stavros rants about bad performances by Vice City's football teams, claims that every other sport isn't manly — and even has an extended take on why Deshaun Watson did nothing wrong. Watson is never mentioned by name, but listen to this for just a few seconds and it's OBVIOUS.

articles.title: Un jugador de los Titans, en el hospital tras sufrir un accidente por una agresión al conductor
articles.standfirst: Jaylen Harrell atacó supuestamente al chófer del vehículo en el que viajaba, que se estrelló tras un brusco viraje
articles.summary: Jaylen Harrell atacó supuestamente al chófer del vehículo en el que viajaba, que se estrelló tras un brusco viraje
articles.body: Jaylen Harrell, jugador de los Tennessee Titans, se encuentra hospitalizado después de sufrir un accidente automovilístico en Florida. Ahora se investiga si Harrell agredió a un conductor de un servicio de transporte compartido momentos antes de la colisión. Según la policía de Tampa, el joven de 24 años viajaba como pasajero en el asiento trasero de un vehículo "cuando presuntamente agredió al conductor mientras el coche se encontraba en movimiento". Eso originó que el conductor, un hombre de unos 35 años, diera un volantazo y chocara contra otro vehículo antes de estrellarse contra un poste. Harrell salió despedido hacia adelante contra el parabrisas y perdió el conocimiento. El conductor sufrió heridas leves y fue atendido en el lugar del accidente. Los Tennessee Titans dijeron en un comunicado que están en "comunicación constante" con la familia de Harrell, además de que se encuentran trabajando para recabar más información. "En este momento, Jaylen permanece hospitalizado y continúa recibiendo atención médica", añadieron los Titans. "Pedimos que se respete la privacidad de Jaylen y su familia. Proporcionaremos una actualización cuando sea oportuno".

articles.title: Do the Packers play today? Schedule, time, channel for next Green Bay NFL game
articles.summary: All you need to know about the Packers' road ahead and how to watch their next game.
articles.body:
The Packers recovered nicely from a rocky start to the season, but they still find themselves at a major disadvantage in the NFC North.

Even at 6-4, Green Bay sits last in the division by more than a game, and head-to-head losses to both the Vikings and Lions stand out as a problem if tiebreakers come into play.

As the Packers try to put a tough home loss to Minnesota behind them, they will have some more time to reflect on what went wrong.

Here's what you need to know about the road ahead for the Packers, including how to watch their next game.

The Packers are on their bye in Week 11, taking the weekend off before resuming their season. Green Bay enters the bye coming off a disappointing home loss to the Vikings, so Packers fans will be watching intently to see if any other NFC North teams lose and keep Jordan Love and co. within striking distance.

The Packers will pick up their season in a first-of-its-kind game against the Rams on Thanksgiving Eve. It will be the NFL's first Thanksgiving Eve game, streaming exclusively on Netflix, featuring two teams who could be fighting for the final NFC wild-card spot.

Here's a look at the next five games on the Packers' schedule.

articles.title: What NFL games are on Thanksgiving in 2026? TV schedule, times, channels for all three games
articles.summary: Here's what to know about the NFL's 2026 Thanksgiving schedule.
articles.body:
For football fans, the best holiday of the year has finally arrived.

Thanksgiving means plenty of NFL action to tune in to, and this year, the league is rolling out a three-game slate full of rivalry matchups — and that's on top of games the day before and after the holiday itself.

There's plenty to know if you want to watch, or listen to, all three Turkey Day games this year.

Here is everything that you need to know to watch the NFL on Thanksgiving in 2026, including a complete schedule with TV and live stream information for every game.

What NFL games are on Thanksgiving in 2026?

The NFC North remains a staple of the Thanksgiving slate, and this year, two high-powered offenses will meet at 1 p.m. ET when the Lions host the Bears .

In the afternoon, while neither team is having the 2026 season they would have hoped for, there's always plenty of heated action whenever the Eagles face the Cowboys . Dallas will host the NFC East showdown.

The quarterback matchup of Thanksgiving arrives in the evening, as Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs will travel to face Josh Allen and the Bills in a meeting between two top AFC contenders.

What channel is Thanksgiving football on?

Fans can stream the first two Thanksgiving games live on Fubo , which offers a free trial. See below for a full rundown of TV channels and streaming options for all three games.

articles.title: Who actually runs Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce's $200 million Garage Beer? Meet the executives working behind the scenes
articles.summary: Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce may be the most recognisable faces associated with Garage Beer, but building a national beer brand takes more than celebrity
articles.body: Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce may be the most recognisable faces associated with Garage Beer, but building a national beer brand takes more than celebrity power. Behind the brothers' public appearances and promotional campaigns is a team of beverage industry professionals handling the business. Founder Andy Sauer leads the company, while executives with experience at major drinks brands oversee finance, sales and marketing. Their work reveals a different side of the Kelce brothers' business venture, one that operates well beyond the football field.Andy Sauer leads Garage Beer as Travis and Jason Kelce remain ownersSauer is the central figure in Garage Beer's management structure. The founder and CEO has guided the brand's growth and remains a significant shareholder alongside the Kelce brothers. When private investment firm Durational Capital Management backed the company in September 2025, Garage Beer confirmed that Travis, Jason and Sauer would remain operators and major shareholders.The brothers have also described themselves as active participants rather than passive investors. In their September 2025 announcement, they said: "A lot of our best memories, celebrations and conversations have come with a beer by our side," said Travis and Jason Kelce, Garage Beer shareholders and operators.However, daily operations require a wider team. Brian Amicon serves as president, while Patrick Brang joined as chief financial officer in March 2026. Brang brings experience from Founders Brewing and BeatBox Beverages. He oversees financial strategy and operations as the company expands.Andrew McGuire, meanwhile, joined as chief revenue officer after spending more than 20 years at Molson Coors. His background in sales, distributor management and national accounts gives Garage Beer experienced leadership in commercial growth.Garage Beer strengthens its marketing and production teamThe company has continued adding specialists as its reach grows. In November 2026, it appointed Justin Kelly as senior vice president of marketing. His previous experience includes roles at Liquid Death and White Claw, two brands known for distinctive marketing.Garage Beer also relies on outside partners to produce and distribute its products. It uses contract brewing rather than operating its own brewery. City Brewing in Memphis has served as its primary production partner, with Founders Brewing in Michigan providing additional capacity. The Molson Coors distributor network has also helped the brand reach customers across the United States.This structure helps explain how the Kelce brothers can remain involved while continuing their careers. They bring ownership, visibility and brand influence, while experienced executives and production partners handle specialised business functions.Garage Beer may carry the Kelce name in the headlines, but its expansion depends on a much larger team working behind the scenes.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
